title.narrative: Provision of life-saving assistance to crisis affected population in Local Government Areas in northeast and northwest Nigeria

description.narrative: WFP will carry out its rapid response efforts in the government established IDP camps, providing in-kind food and nutrition assistance to 111,400 displaced persons and host communities in Borno state. WFP will distribute hot meals and take-home rations to facilitate the return of displaced individuals to their residences. These take-home rations, which will include 10 kg of pulses and 25 kg of rice, will be distributed once. In addition, a total of 64,600 people in Borno (51,680 people) and Sokoto (12,920 people) will receive cash transfers. WFP has already forged strong partnerships with a number of local NGOs that will carry out the distributions and set up community feedback systems to guarantee that AAP and protection principles are followed. WFP and its partners will also ensure the implementation of a robust monitoring system, which will encompass post-distribution monitoring (PDM). WFP will also provide humanitarian air services to UN agencies and NGOs, thus enabling humanitarian access to vulnerable communities affected by flooding in northeast Nigeria.
